source: ISO 4217 active codes (lib/core/currencies.ts); minor units per ISO 4217; HUF overridden per the multi-market spec §A.2.

rows.processor_notes: ISO 4217 gives HUF two minor digits, but the fillér was withdrawn in 1999: amounts round and display in whole forints. Stripe requires HUF amounts divisible by 100 (whole forints) in several operations, asserted at the billing boundary. Prices round to the nearest 500 HUF.

notes: presentation: 'home' renders with the row's own symbol and separators in every surface (HUF: '35 413 Ft' whoever reads it); 'reader' renders in the reader's language through Intl, with the row's decimals and rounding (EUR is written differently across the euro area).
